overview_description.description:
Framer is an AI company building a design agent for the web. The agent works directly on a freeform canvas, turning prompts into layouts, content, components, interactions, responsive designs, and code. Everything it creates remains visible and editable, so users can guide the agent, refine its work, or take over on the canvas at any point.
The agent can start from an idea or work across an existing project. It can design pages, update content, manage CMS collections, organize styles, review accessibility and SEO, analyze traffic, and prepare changes for publishing. Framer also connects with external agents such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.
Framer supports the full process from idea to launch with collaboration, branching, localization, analytics, performance tools, and hosting built in. Its community shares templates, plugins, components, and tutorials that expand what creators can make.
